purpose: Mandatory interpretation boundaries for final Phase J synthesis.

boundaries.interpretation: H0 and H1 isolate the historical Logistic Regression class-weighting change under their shared image representation and data protocol.
boundaries.prohibited_inference: Do not generalize this comparison into evidence about deep-model architecture effects.

boundaries.interpretation: The progression changes representation, resolution, training sample count, ImageNet pretraining, augmentation, and architecture together.
boundaries.prohibited_inference: Do not present the observed difference as an isolated architecture effect.

boundaries.interpretation: This is the cleanest architecture-family comparison because the external data, image, transform, loss, optimizer, checkpoint, and threshold protocol is matched.
boundaries.prohibited_inference: Do not assign the difference causally to an individual ConvNeXt component.

boundaries.interpretation: This is the principal image-only versus metadata-fusion system comparison under the matched external protocol.
boundaries.prohibited_inference: Do not treat per-sample M2-minus-M1 probability differences as causal metadata contributions because the models were independently trained.

boundaries.interpretation: A difference records that M2 changed a prediction or probability relative to M1.
boundaries.prohibited_inference: Do not claim that age, sex, or anatomical site caused the individual change.

boundaries.interpretation: The bootstrap quantifies internal uncertainty for paired M1/M2 metric differences on Fold 0 while preserving patient-cluster multiplicity.
boundaries.prohibited_inference: Do not describe the intervals as external validation or independent-test uncertainty.

boundaries.interpretation: Grad-CAM targets the raw melanoma logit and shows coarse image-branch spatial attribution conditioned on supplied metadata.
boundaries.prohibited_inference: Do not present it as an explanation of metadata contribution, benign-class evidence, clinical reasoning, or causality.
